profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Hi there! I'm an energetic full-stack software engineer with experience in developing elegant, reusable code for high-visibility products. I lean slightly towards front end as I have a proven track record of delivering scalable, understandable, and testable user interfaces with a strong focus on user experience. However, I've had a wide range of full stack experiences ranging from service secret management and infrastructure automation all the way to API design and implementing web accessibility standards. I'm a supportive team player who enjoys mentoring junior developers and sharing my knowledge with anyone who's willing to listen :)

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Planned, developed, and maintained user interfaces for identity provisioning management flows in the Azure/Entra portal. Proven track record of designing and delivering elegant solutions for high-privileged, complex operations.
- Excellent communicator and excels at translating requirements between engineering, product management, and design teams.
- Able to balance and prioritize having different requirements from multiple stakeholders, and concentrate efforts on areas with most impact. 
- Part of on call rotation and mentored junior engineers

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Developed features for hybrid authentication methods such as Passthrough authentication and authentication with password hashes. 
-Was a part of on call rotations, performed server maintenance, and contributed to service design

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Developing a RESTful API service to serve medical data to hundreds of partners. Developed several endpoints and workflows to allow third party applications to utilize data directly from doctors.
- Developed and maintained a patient portal for thousands of patients to review and enter data for their doctors to review. Developed multiple workflows for different types of medical data.
- Perforce, Git, and Jira task tracking. Using technologies such as HTML, CSS/Less, Javascript, JQuery, and Perl.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed an internal workflow rendering web application that tracked the development status of products. Increased speed in which new products are introduced, increased automation within the process, and reduced reporting errors.
- Managed release process of application, took feedback regularly to cater product to stakeholder needs.
- Developed application using KnockoutJS C#, Jira, Git, and Fiddler.

positions.title: Undergraduate Programming Mentor
positions.description: Helped students to complete exercises in lab assigned by the professor. Worked under a graduate teaching assistant. Mentored Computer Science 1 and Introduction to Algorithms.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research
positions.description: Graphics Research under Xiaolei Huang. Worked on image extraction from PDFs and metadata processing.

honors.title: HackRPI 2015: Best use of Bose Soundtouch Speaker
honors.description: Created MY(TEMP)O, an interactive Myo armband controller for the Bose Soundtouch Speaker.

honors.title: YHack 2015: 1st Place, Best use of Intel Edison Module
honors.description: Developed 'Check Me Out', a NFC chip based self checkout system.
